task.description:
Draft the scale-anchor section for EXP-101.

Scale numbers chosen by operator:
- Target tenants: 500
- Ceiling tenants: 5,000 (at which point db_host sharding / read replicas become necessary)

Tasks:
1. Add a 'Scale Anchor' section to docs/BPM_Platform_Backend_Architecture.md stating the target and ceiling.
2. Annotate each single-primary / single-sweep simplification with a cross-reference to the scale anchor (schema-per-tenant, startup sweep single-node lock, SKIP LOCKED scheduler).
3. List large-N escape hatches (db_host sharding, read replicas) as explicitly deferred.
4. Acceptance: architecture doc has the scale-anchor section; every single-node claim cites it.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture doc has a 'Scale Anchor' section stating 500 target / 5,000 ceiling tenants
Each single-primary / schema-per-tenant simplification annotated with a citation to the scale anchor
Large-N escape hatches (db_host sharding, read replicas) listed as deferred

result.summary: Added Scale Anchor section to docs/BPM_Platform_Backend_Architecture.md: 500 target / 5,000 ceiling tenants, escape hatches (db_host sharding, read replicas, schema packing) listed as deferred, and all single-primary / single-sweep simplifications annotated with scale-anchor cross-references.
